plugin.name: GTA Chinatown Wars PPSSPP Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows PPSSPP stretch settings. Use a ratio such as 21:9 or 32:9 to override it. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
ModernControls.description: Map PSP R/L to RT/LT in the emulator: R accelerates or fires, L brakes or aims. On foot Circle keeps the displaced shoulder action; when driving Cross and Square keep the displaced driving actions. PDA, menu and minigame controls stay native. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
Enable3rdPersonCamera.description: Switch cameras with D-pad Right and adjust the third-person view with the right stick. The original cinematic camera is disabled. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
RadioInAllVehicles.description: Allow radio playback in emergency vehicles. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading and PDA transitions. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnlockXinMissionsInReplayBoard.descripti: Experimental replay-board availability override. Does not alter saved mission progress. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logo movie at startup. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HudScale.description: Scale the complete gameplay HUD around screen-edge anchors. PDA applications retain native proportions. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
FOVFactor.description: Scales the gameplay field of view from 0.5 to 2.0; 1.0 keeps the original angle, higher values show more of the city. Story scenes keep their own framing. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the gameplay HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the game's cinematic bars above and below story scenes and scripted shots. Pillarbox adds side bars on screens wider than 16:9, so in-game shots keep their original framing like the comic panels. Off shows the shots without bars. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
